title_en: Leave the Road Open: The Record

commands.text: The last carrier breaks apart on the road. No bell sounds, and no light rises from the pit.

commands.speaker: ac_tovin_reed
commands.text: I thought there would be a sign.

commands.speaker: ac_mera_holt
commands.text: There is a road people can use. There is a record they can read. Those are our signs.

commands.speaker: jori_flint
commands.text: The dead still need witnesses. The village will send people who remember, not another captain.

commands.speaker: jori_flint
commands.text: I have a gate to hold. You have a gate to stop closing.
Mera leaves one clean space at the end of the page. It is not a name invented to make the work feel finished.
